title: Festive Flare Spice Cakes
description: Moist and flavorful spice cakes with a hint of festive flair, perfect for special occasions.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (180°C). Grease a 12-cup muffin tin.
In a medium bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
In a large bowl, whisk together eggs, milk, and melted butter.
Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and stir until just combined.
Stir in allspice, flare, and sugar.
Divide the batter evenly among the muffin cups.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center of a cake comes out clean.
Allow the cakes to cool in the pan for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.
